mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_learning_profile ( user_id, school_stage, grade, textbook, interests_json ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{schoolStage}, #{grade}, #{textbook}, CAST(#{interestsJson} AS JSON) ) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE school_stage = incoming.school_stage, grade = incoming.grade, textbook = incoming.textbook, interests_json = incoming.interests_json, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
